name: BVBRC_get_genome
description: Get the complete genome record exposed by BV-BRC, including all assembly, quality, CheckM, accession, sequencing, host, disease, and isolation fields. Set include_related=true to additionally retrieve the first explicitly paginated page of AMR phenotypes and specialty genes for the exact genome under related_records; metadata then reports independent totals and next offsets. Example: '83332.12' returns Mycobacterium tuberculosis H37Rv.

genome_id.description: BV-BRC genome identifier (taxon_id.version format). Examples: '83332.12' (M. tuberculosis H37Rv), '511145.12' (E. coli K-12 MG1655), '93061.5' (S. aureus NCTC 8325).

include_related.description: Also retrieve paginated AMR phenotype and specialty-gene records for this exact genome. Default: false, because each related collection costs an extra request; metadata.related_data names the dedicated tools to call instead.

related_limit.description: Maximum AMR and specialty-gene records returned per related collection.

related_offset.description: Zero-based offset for both related collections. Their independent next offsets are reported in metadata.related_pagination.

assembly_accession.description: INSDC assembly accession for this genome, e.g. 'GCA_000195955.2'. The '.2' is the assembly version, so two BV-BRC genomes of the same strain can differ here.

bioproject_accession.description: NCBI BioProject the genome was submitted under, e.g. 'PRJNA224'.

biosample_accession.description: NCBI BioSample for the physical sample sequenced, e.g. 'SAMEA3138326'. This is what links the genome to the isolate's own metadata.

genbank_accessions.description: GenBank accession(s) for the sequence records, comma-separated in ONE string, e.g. 'AL123456'. A multi-replicon genome puts every accession in this single field.

refseq_accessions.description: RefSeq accession(s), comma-separated in one string, e.g. 'NC_000962'.

ncbi_project_id.description: NCBI project id as a string, e.g. '224'.

refseq_project_id.description: RefSeq project id as a string, e.g. '57777'.

p2_genome_id.description: Internal PATRIC-2 numeric id, e.g. 87468. Legacy; use genome_id for anything citable.

mlst.description: MLST scheme and sequence type, e.g. 'MLST.mycobacteria_2.874' -- scheme name, scheme version, then ST.

publication.description: PubMed IDs for the genome's publications, comma-separated in ONE string, e.g. '9634230,12368430'. Not a list; split on ','.

checkm_completeness.description: CheckM completeness as a percentage, e.g. 100. Below ~90 the gene counts in this record understate the real genome.

checkm_contamination.description: CheckM contamination as a percentage, e.g. 0. Above ~5 the assembly probably mixes more than one organism.

coarse_consistency.description: Coarse functional consistency score from RASTtk annotation, e.g. 99.9 -- how well the called roles agree with closely related genomes.

fine_consistency.description: Fine functional consistency score, e.g. 99.9. Lower than coarse_consistency when individual roles disagree even though the broad set is right.

genome_quality.description: BV-BRC's own overall verdict, e.g. 'Good'. Derived from the CheckM and consistency scores in this same record.

contig_n50.description: Contig N50 in bases, e.g. 4411532 -- half the assembly sits in contigs at least this long. For this complete genome it equals the chromosome length.

contig_l50.description: Contig L50: how many contigs it takes to reach half the assembly, e.g. 1.

cds_ratio.description: Coding density: the fraction of the genome inside CDS features, e.g. 0.99.

patric_cds.description: CDS called by BV-BRC's own (PATRIC/RASTtk) annotation, e.g. 4367.

refseq_cds.description: CDS in the RefSeq annotation of the same genome, e.g. 3989. It differs from patric_cds because the two pipelines call genes differently; comparing them is the point of carrying both.

hypothetical_cds.description: CDS annotated only as 'hypothetical protein', e.g. 1021.

hypothetical_cds_ratio.description: Hypothetical CDS as a fraction of all CDS, e.g. 0.23 -- how much of the gene content is uncharacterised.

partial_cds.description: CDS running off the end of a contig, e.g. 0. A high count means the assembly is fragmented.

partial_cds_ratio.description: Partial CDS as a fraction of all CDS, e.g. 0.

plfam_cds.description: CDS assigned to a PATRIC local protein family (PLfam), e.g. 4364.

plfam_cds_ratio.description: Fraction of CDS with a PLfam assignment, e.g. 1.

taxon_lineage_ids.description: NCBI taxon ids from root to this genome, 11 entries on the measured record, starting '131567' (cellular organisms). Positionally parallel to taxon_lineage_names.

taxon_lineage_names.description: The same lineage as names, 11 entries starting 'cellular organisms'. Parallel to taxon_lineage_ids, so zip the two.

cgmlst_hc0.description: cgMLST hierarchical cluster at 0 allele differences, e.g. '27109' -- effectively identical genomes. HC0 through HC100 are a nested outbreak-clustering ladder: two genomes sharing an HC code differ by at most that many cgMLST alleles.

cgmlst_hc2.description: cgMLST cluster at up to 2 allele differences, e.g. '27109'. See cgmlst_hc0 for how the ladder works.

cgmlst_hc5.description: cgMLST cluster at up to 5 allele differences, e.g. '27109'.

cgmlst_hc10.description: cgMLST cluster at up to 10 allele differences, e.g. '27109'.

cgmlst_hc20.description: cgMLST cluster at up to 20 allele differences, e.g. '27028'.

cgmlst_hc50.description: cgMLST cluster at up to 50 allele differences, e.g. '26882'.

cgmlst_hc100.description: cgMLST cluster at up to 100 allele differences, e.g. '26882' -- the loosest rung, roughly a lineage rather than an outbreak.

gram_stain.description: Gram reaction as a sign, e.g. '+'.

motility.description: Whether the organism is motile, e.g. 'No'.

sporulation.description: Whether the organism forms spores, e.g. 'No'.

optimal_temperature.description: Optimal growth temperature in Celsius, as a STRING, e.g. '37'.

isolation_source.description: Where the isolate came from, e.g. 'derived from the original human-lung H37 isolate'.

isolation_comments.description: Free-text isolation history; on H37Rv it records the 1934 derivation from the original human-lung H37 isolate and the passaging since. This is the field that says whether a 'reference' strain is lab-adapted.

comments.description: Free-text submitter comments, one string per entry. On H37Rv the single entry is the strain-history note.

sequencing_centers.description: Centre that produced the sequence, e.g. 'Wellcome Trust Sanger Institute'.

reference_genome.description: Whether BV-BRC treats this as a reference or representative genome, e.g. 'Reference'. Empty on ordinary genomes.

owner.description: Owning group of the record, e.g. 'PATRIC'.

public.description: Whether the genome is public, e.g. true. A private genome is visible only to its owner.

date_inserted.description: When BV-BRC first loaded the record, ISO-8601 UTC, e.g. '2014-12-08T22:12:10.274Z'.

date_modified.description: When the record was last changed, e.g. '2015-03-16T03:17:09.594Z'. Older than date_inserted is impossible; a recent value means the annotation moved.

_version_.description: Solr's internal optimistic-concurrency stamp, e.g. 1865149608110325800. Not a genome version and not comparable between records -- use date_modified to tell which copy is newer.

name: BVBRC_search_genomes
description: Search for pathogen genomes in BV-BRC by organism name or keyword, with explicit pagination and optional genome status, quality, CheckM, and collection-date filters. The response metadata reports the true total from BV-BRC's Content-Range header, whether the page is truncated, and the next offset. Example: 'Staphylococcus aureus' returns S. aureus genome assemblies.

keyword.description: Search keyword - organism name, strain, or pathogen. Examples: 'Staphylococcus aureus', 'Escherichia coli', 'Salmonella enterica', 'SARS-CoV-2'.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return per page. Default: 10. Max: 100.

offset.description: Zero-based result offset. Use metadata.next_offset to retrieve the next page. Default: 0.

genome_status.description: Exact BV-BRC genome status filter, such as 'Complete' or 'WGS'.

genome_quality.description: Exact BV-BRC genome quality classification filter, such as 'Good'.

collection_date_start.description: Inclusive lower bound for collection_date, in the date format accepted by BV-BRC.

collection_date_end.description: Inclusive upper bound for collection_date, in the date format accepted by BV-BRC.

gc_content.description: GC content as a PERCENTAGE, e.g. 65.4 -- not a fraction.

isolation_country.description: Country the isolate came from, e.g. 'Peru'. Present on only 1 of the 5 hits measured, so it cannot be used to filter a search result without losing most of it.

name: BVBRC_search_amr
description: Search for ANTIBACTERIAL resistance (AMR) phenotype data in BV-BRC -- bacteria tested against antibiotics (e.g. 'methicillin', 'ciprofloxacin'), NOT antiviral drug-resistance mutations (for influenza/viral antiviral resistance, use Pathoplexus_get_mutations or literature search instead). Returns resistance/susceptibility data for pathogens against specific antibiotics, including MIC values, testing methods, and evidence. Results are explicitly paginated; metadata reports the true total, truncation state, and next offset. Filter by 'antibiotic', 'resistant_phenotype', and/or a specific BV-BRC 'genome_id'. There is no organism/species parameter: to scope results to one organism, first obtain its genome_id(s) and pass genome_id here.

antibiotic.description: Antibiotic name to search for. Examples: 'methicillin', 'vancomycin', 'ciprofloxacin', 'amikacin', 'isoniazid'.

genome_id.description: BV-BRC genome ID to get AMR data for a specific genome. Example: '83332.12'.

limit.description: Maximum number of results per page. Default: 25. Max: 100.

offset.description: Zero-based result offset. Use metadata.next_offset to retrieve the next page. Default: 0.

taxon_id.description: NCBI taxonomy ids for the structure's source organisms, e.g. [2697049] (SARS-CoV-2). A list, since a complex can span organisms.

name: BVBRC_search_genome_features
description: Search for genome features (genes, proteins, CDS) in BV-BRC pathogen genomes with explicit pagination. Metadata reports the true Content-Range total, truncation state, and next offset.

gene.description: Gene name to search for. Examples: 'mecA' (methicillin resistance), 'blaTEM' (beta-lactamase), 'katG' (isoniazid resistance).

product.description: Gene product keyword to search. Examples: 'beta-lactamase', 'penicillin-binding protein', 'DNA gyrase'.

genome_id.description: Restrict search to a specific genome. Example: '83332.12'.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Default: 10. Max: 100.

keyword.description: Alias for product: gene product keyword to search (e.g., 'spike protein', 'beta-lactamase').

offset.description: Zero-based result offset. Use metadata.next_offset to continue.

genome_id.description: BV-BRC genome the feature belongs to, e.g. '208199.11'. A feature search spans genomes, so this is what says which one each row came from.

name: BVBRC_search_epitopes
description: Search for pathogen epitopes (B-cell and T-cell) in BV-BRC with explicit pagination. Metadata reports the true total and next offset.

taxon_id.description: NCBI Taxonomy ID for the pathogen organism. Examples: '2697049' (SARS-CoV-2), '11320' (Influenza A), '1773' (M. tuberculosis).

protein_name.description: Target protein name to filter epitopes. Examples: 'Spike glycoprotein', 'Nucleocapsid protein', 'Replicase polyprotein 1ab'.

epitope_type.description: Type of epitope. Options: 'Linear peptide', 'Discontinuous peptide'. Most epitopes are linear peptides.

organism.description: Organism name keyword to search across epitope records. Example: 'coronavirus', 'influenza'.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Default: 25. Max: 100.

offset.description: Zero-based result offset. Use metadata.next_offset to continue.

taxon_id.description: NCBI taxonomy ids for the structure's source organisms, e.g. [2697049] (SARS-CoV-2). A list, since a complex can span organisms.

name: BVBRC_search_surveillance
description: Search influenza and pathogen surveillance data in BV-BRC with explicit pagination and true Content-Range totals.

subtype.description: Influenza subtype to search for. Examples: 'H5N1', 'H1N1', 'H3N2', 'H7N9'. Common in surveillance tracking.

geographic_group.description: Geographic region filter. Options: 'North America', 'Europe', 'Asia', 'Africa', 'South America', 'Oceania'.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Default: 25. Max: 100.

offset.description: Zero-based result offset. Use metadata.next_offset to continue.

sample_accession.description: Human-readable submission accession (e.g. 'IRD_ROC000000507'). Multiple records can share the same sample_accession/sample_identifier when a sample was tested/submitted more than once -- use 'id' to distinguish them.

id.description: Unique BV-BRC record identifier for this surveillance entry.

name: BVBRC_search_specialty_genes
description: Search for specialty genes in BV-BRC including virulence factors, antibiotic resistance genes, drug targets, and human homologs. Filter by exact genome_id, taxon, gene, property, or source. Results are explicitly paginated and metadata reports the true total and next offset.

gene.description: Gene name to search. Examples: 'mecA' (methicillin resistance), 'katG' (isoniazid resistance), 'drrC' (efflux pump).

property.description: Specialty gene property category. Options: 'Antibiotic Resistance', 'Virulence Factor', 'Drug Target', 'Transporter', 'Human Homolog'.

taxon_id.description: NCBI Taxonomy ID. Examples: '1280' (S. aureus), '1773' (M. tuberculosis), '562' (E. coli).

genome_id.description: Exact BV-BRC genome ID, such as '83332.12'. Use this to retrieve specialty genes for one assembly rather than every genome in a taxon.

limit.description: Maximum number of results per page. Default: 25. Max: 100.

offset.description: Zero-based result offset. Use metadata.next_offset to continue.

organism.description: Organism of BV-BRC's reference annotation source for this hit -- NOT the organism carrying the gene, and frequently a different species. Use `genome_name` for the carrier.

genome_name.description: Name of the genome the gene was actually found in, which is what 'which species carries this gene' means. Agrees with `taxon_id`.

name: BVBRC_get_protein_structure
description: Get detailed pathogen protein structure information from BV-BRC by PDB ID. Returns structure metadata including title, resolution, method, gene, organism, UniProt accession, PMID references, sequence, and taxonomic lineage. Useful for structural biology research on pathogen proteins. Example: '6VSB' returns the SARS-CoV-2 spike glycoprotein structure.

pdb_id.description: PDB identifier for the protein structure. Examples: '6VSB' (SARS-CoV-2 spike), '7CMD' (SARS-CoV-2 PLpro), '6VW1' (SARS-CoV-2 RBD-ACE2 complex).

feature_id.description: BV-BRC feature id for this record, e.g. "RefSeq.83332.12.NC_000962.CDS.2448160.2449962.fwd".

_version_.description: Solr's internal concurrency stamp. Not a version of the structure and not comparable between records.

alignments.description: How the PDB chains map onto the protein sequence, one string per chain, e.g. 'A:1-1208,P0DTC2:1-1208' -- chain range, then the sequence range it aligns to. This is what says which part of the protein the structure actually resolves.

authors.description: Authors of the structure, 'Surname, I.' per entry, e.g. 'Wang, N.'.

date_inserted.description: When BV-BRC loaded the record, e.g. '2021-12-21T11:58:37.044Z'.

date_modified.description: When the record last changed, e.g. '2021-12-21T11:58:37.044Z'.

file_path.description: Path of the coordinate file inside BV-BRC's store, e.g. 'pdb/6VSB.pdb'. A path, not a URL.

genome_id.description: BV-BRC genome the protein belongs to, e.g. '2697049.107626'.

patric_id.description: BV-BRC feature id of the protein the structure covers, e.g. 'fig|2697049.107626.CDS.3'.

sequence.description: The full amino-acid sequence(s) of the modelled protein, one string per distinct chain sequence.

sequence_md5.description: MD5 of each entry in `sequence`, positionally parallel to it, e.g. '4c35f09aac2f7be4f3cffd30c6aecac8'. BV-BRC's own cross-reference key for an identical sequence elsewhere.

taxon_lineage_ids.description: NCBI taxon ids from root to the source organism, 13 entries starting '10239' (Viruses). Parallel to taxon_lineage_names.

taxon_lineage_names.description: The same lineage as names, starting 'Viruses'. Parallel to taxon_lineage_ids.

oneOf.description: Required so this branch stops matching the error envelope. oneOf needs exactly one branch to match, and with nothing required here a correct {status, error} result satisfied both branches and failed validation. Measured present in all 13 successful payloads. Two identity fields rather than all 22 always-present keys, so one optional field going missing upstream does not start failing correct results.

name: BVBRC_search_protein_structures
description: Search for pathogen protein structures in BV-BRC by organism, gene, or method, with explicit pagination and true totals.

taxon_id.description: NCBI Taxonomy ID. Examples: '2697049' (SARS-CoV-2), '1773' (M. tuberculosis), '11320' (Influenza A).

method.description: Experimental method. Examples: 'X-ray diffraction', 'Electron microscopy', 'Solution NMR'.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Default: 10. Max: 100.

offset.description: Zero-based result offset. Use metadata.next_offset to continue.

taxon_id.description: NCBI taxonomy ids for the structure's source organisms, e.g. [2697049] (SARS-CoV-2). A list, since a complex can span organisms.

name: BVBRC_get_taxonomy
description: Get detailed taxonomy information for a pathogen from BV-BRC by NCBI Taxonomy ID. Returns taxon name, rank, lineage, alternative names, and genome counts. Useful for resolving pathogen taxonomy and understanding classification hierarchy. Example: '2697049' returns SARS-CoV-2 taxonomy with full lineage from Viruses to species.

taxon_id.description: NCBI Taxonomy ID. Examples: '2697049' (SARS-CoV-2), '1773' (M. tuberculosis), '1280' (S. aureus), '11320' (Influenza A).

_version_.description: Solr's internal concurrency stamp; not a taxonomy version.

division.description: GenBank division of the taxon, e.g. 'Viruses'.

genetic_code.description: NCBI translation table number for this taxon, e.g. 1 (the standard code). Translating a CDS with the wrong table silently produces the wrong protein.

lineage.description: The full lineage as ONE comma-separated string, e.g. 'Viruses,Riboviria,Orthornavirae,...'. Not a list; split on ','.

lineage_ranks.description: The rank name for each step of the lineage, 13 entries starting 'acellular root'. Positionally parallel to the comma-split `lineage`, which is the only way to tell which element is the species.

parent_id.description: NCBI taxon id of the parent node, e.g. 3418604. Walk this to climb the tree one rank at a time.

name: BVBRC_search_taxonomy
description: Search for pathogen taxonomy entries in BV-BRC by keyword, with explicit pagination and true Content-Range totals.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Default: 10. Max: 100.

offset.description: Zero-based result offset. Use metadata.next_offset to continue.

name: BVBRC_search_pathways
description: Search for metabolic pathways in BV-BRC with explicit pagination. Metadata reports the true row total and next offset; distinct gene/annotation rows remain distinguishable.

taxon_id.description: NCBI Taxonomy ID. Examples: '1773' (M. tuberculosis), '562' (E. coli), '1280' (S. aureus).

pathway_name.description: Pathway name keyword. Examples: 'Glycolysis', 'Fatty acid', 'Amino acid', 'Sulfur metabolism'.

genome_id.description: Restrict to a specific genome. Example: '83332.12' (M. tuberculosis H37Rv).

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Default: 25. Max: 100.

offset.description: Zero-based result offset. Use metadata.next_offset to continue.

gene.description: Gene symbol for this pathway/EC record, e.g. "fadD15". Distinguishes genuinely different genes sharing the same EC number/pathway from true duplicate rows.

feature_id.description: BV-BRC feature id for this record, e.g. "RefSeq.83332.12.NC_000962.CDS.2448160.2449962.fwd".

annotation.description: Annotation source, e.g. "RefSeq" or "PATRIC" -- the same EC/pathway is often independently annotated by multiple sources.

name: BVBRC_search_subsystems
description: Search for functional subsystems in BV-BRC with explicit pagination and true Content-Range totals.

taxon_id.description: NCBI Taxonomy ID. Examples: '1773' (M. tuberculosis), '1280' (S. aureus), '562' (E. coli).

superclass.description: Top-level functional category. Options include: 'METABOLISM', 'STRESS RESPONSE, DEFENSE, VIRULENCE', 'ENERGY', 'CELLULAR PROCESSES', 'DNA PROCESSING', 'PROTEIN PROCESSING', 'CELL ENVELOPE', 'RNA PROCESSING'.

subsystem_name.description: Subsystem name keyword. Examples: 'mycothiol', 'iron acquisition', 'beta-lactam resistance'.

role_name.description: Specific functional role keyword. Examples: 'catalase', 'penicillin-binding protein'.

genome_id.description: Restrict to a specific genome. Example: '83332.12'.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Default: 25. Max: 100.

offset.description: Zero-based result offset. Use metadata.next_offset to continue.
